run_steps.name: run-01-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m py_compile leescan.py test_leescan.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-02-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python leescan.py --fetch-only > /out/fetch.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/fetch.txt; sha256sum leescan.py test_leescan.py aprime_smooth.py emuframe.py aleph-fig5.json | tee /out/sha256.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-03-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m unittest -v test_leescan > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-04-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python leescan.py --out /out --ntoys 2000 --workers 2 --budget-s 14000 > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(CLOSURE|OBS|budget|LEESCAN)' /out/run.txt; tail -n 60 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
